name: Supabase MCP
tagline: Manage your Supabase project — Postgres, auth, storage, edge functions.
shortDescription: The official Supabase MCP server. Query your Postgres, manage auth users, list storage buckets, deploy edge functions, and inspect logs. All from your agent.
longDescription:
## What it does

A complete bridge to your Supabase project. Read and write Postgres, manage auth users, upload files to storage, invoke edge functions, and read the project logs. It's the operations console as a set of MCP tools.

## Why we recommend it

The Postgres support is much richer than the standalone Postgres MCP server — it understands Supabase-specific things like RLS policies, the `auth` schema, and `storage.objects`. Plus you get the rest of the Supabase platform for free.

## Common patterns

- "How many users signed up today?"
- "Add a new column to the `orders` table"
- "Show me the last 20 auth log entries"
- "Deploy this edge function and tail its logs"
installInstructions:
1. Create a personal access token at https://supabase.com/dashboard/account/tokens
2. Set `SUPABASE_ACCESS_TOKEN=sbp_your-token` in your environment
3. Run the install command
4. Optional: set `SUPABASE_PROJECT_REF=your-project-ref` to scope to one project
